description: Header file defining the Grapher class in the GraphControl namespace, which manages graph rendering, user interaction, and properties for a graph control in a Windows UI application.

classes.name: Grapher
classes.description: A sealed ref class managing graph rendering, user interaction, and properties for a graph control in a Windows UI application.

methods.name: ZoomFromCenter
methods.description: Zooms the graph from the center by a specified scale.

methods.name: ResetGrid
methods.description: Resets the grid to default view.

methods.name: SetVariable
methods.description: Sets the value of a variable by name.

methods.name: ConvertToLinear
methods.description: Converts a MathML string to a linear format.

methods.name: PlotGraph
methods.description: Draws the graph, optionally keeping the current view.

methods.name: AnalyzeEquation
methods.description: Analyzes a given equation for key features.

methods.name: GetDisplayRanges
methods.description: Retrieves current display ranges for x and y axes.

methods.name: SetDisplayRanges
methods.description: Sets display ranges for x and y axes.

methods.name: OnEquationStyleChanged
methods.description: Handles style change in an equation.

methods.name: OnEquationLineEnabledChanged
methods.description: Handles line enabled state change in an equation.

methods.name: TryUpdateGraph
methods.description: Attempts to update the graph with current settings.

methods.name: TryPlotGraph
methods.description: Attempts to plot the graph, with retry logic.

methods.name: UpdateGraphOptions
methods.description: Updates graph options based on equations.

methods.name: SetGraphArgs
methods.description: Sets the graph object for rendering.

methods.name: GetGraph
methods.description: Retrieves the graph object for a specific equation.

methods.name: UpdateVariables
methods.description: Updates variables used in the graph.

methods.name: ScaleRange
methods.description: Scales the view range centered at given x and y.

methods.name: TryInitializeGraph
methods.description: Initializes the graph with current equations and settings.
